Workbench.Title: Channel directory
Workbench.Description: Find a registered pipeline, inspect its endpoints and ordered middleware, and operate on its real host state.
Workbench.DirectoryDescription: Inspect registered channel pipelines, endpoint metadata, middleware evidence and message capture.
Workbench.ExceptionsDescription: Inspect retained channel exceptions and lifetime counters, or clear a channel’s retained observable history.
Workbench.UnavailableHelp: No complete management capture is available. Refresh to try again.
Workbench.PreviousCaptureHelp: The previous complete capture remains visible. Its timestamp has not advanced.
Workbench.LoadingDescription: Reading registered channels, component metadata and retained observable history.
Workbench.SummaryLabel: All registered channels at capture time
Workbench.ScopeHelp: Initialization describes local endpoint setup. It does not prove remote transport availability or successful message delivery. Retained exceptions are a separate evidence axis.
Workbench.HistoryCleared: Retained observable history for channel {0} was cleared. Lifetime counters remain.

Directory.Title: Find a channel
Directory.SearchPlaceholder: Channel ID, group or endpoint type
Directory.EmptyHelp: Register a channel pipeline to expose its local setup and captured evidence here.
Directory.NoMatchesHelp: Adjust the search or filters to compare other registered channels.
Directory.MissingChannel: The selected channel is not registered
Directory.MissingChannelHelp: The exact identity above is absent from this capture. Show all channels to choose an available registration.

ExceptionWorkbench.Title: Exception evidence
ExceptionWorkbench.Description: Read retained failures in context, compare them with lifetime counters, and manage each channel’s bounded history.
ExceptionWorkbench.SummaryLabel: Captured exception evidence across all channels
ExceptionWorkbench.RetentionHelp: History is bounded. Clearing or trimming retained records leaves lifetime exception counters intact.

ExceptionDirectory.Title: Channel exception ledger
ExceptionDirectory.Description: Inspect the retained subset, exact pipeline identity and shared history capacity for each channel.
ExceptionDirectory.CapacityHelp: History capacity is shared by ordinary records and exceptions. A channel with no retained exceptions may still hold ordinary records; clearing history removes both.

PipelineInspector.FrozenHelp: This inspector shows the captured evidence from when it opened.
PipelineInspector.MessagePath: Two source directions, one transform order
PipelineInspector.DirectionHelp: Both source directions run the transform sequence below, then dispatch to the opposite endpoint. The sequence is not reversed for an outer source.
PipelineInspector.NoTransforms: No transform middleware. Messages dispatch directly to the opposite endpoint.
PipelineInspector.EndpointConfigurationHelp: These entries configure endpoints. They are separate from the per-message transform sequence.
PipelineInspector.NoEndpointConfiguration: No endpoint configuration middleware is registered.
PipelineInspector.Transient: Transient: a new component is created for each operation.
PipelineInspector.MiddlewareHelp: Configuration entries appear first, followed by transforms in their actual order. Actions resolve the exact registered component separately from this frozen evidence.
PipelineInspector.NoMiddleware: No middleware is registered for this channel.

Metadata.CaptureFailed: This value could not be captured.

ClearHistory.Description: Delete the observable records currently retained by this channel.
ClearHistory.Scope: This clears all retained records, including ordinary records and exceptions. The removed evidence cannot be recovered from this history.
ClearHistory.LifetimeHelp: Lifetime counters are preserved. This action does not reinitialize endpoints, recover a channel, or resolve a failure.

Details.Title: Exception details
Details.SubsetHelp: Retained counts cover the full current history. The list below is the requested most recent subset; lifetime counters include exceptions whose evidence was cleared or trimmed.
Details.CaptureFailed: Some exception evidence could not be captured.
Details.Empty: This capture has no retained exception details.
Details.NoMatches: No exception records match the grid filters.

Debugger.CaptureScope: Messages are captured before target endpoint dispatch. Captured payloads do not prove downstream receipt.
Debugger.SettingsHelp: Keyword matching is case-insensitive. Settings apply when capture starts; pause capture to change them.
Debugger.DraftHelp: Your edited settings apply on the next Start. The host currently uses keyword {0} and capture depth {1}.

States.NoMessagesDescription: Start capture and send a message matching the keyword. The bounded queue may also have been cleared.

Debugger.DetachedSelection: This selected snapshot remains available after its queue entry was trimmed or cleared.
Debugger.NoMetadata: No metadata was captured for this message.
Debugger.CloseHelp: Closing this inspector stops its polling. Host capture continues until Stop capture is selected, including capture used by another inspector.

Messages.ReadFailed: The latest queue read failed: {0}. Previous captured messages remain visible.
